title: Doesn't work - Don't Recommend it
text: Doesn't work - Don't Recommend it. Box came in as was very flimsy.  Not sturdy at all. Looks nice but, after I put in battery it went around for about an hour, then it stops ticking. It doesn't work - I don't recommend it

product_metadata.title: Wall Clock, Square Silent Non Ticking Clock 12 Inch, Shell Sand Summer Time Beach, Home Decor for Living Room, Bathroom, Bedroom, Kitchen, Office or School
features: 【Universal Size】12" x 12" x 0.2", unique square shape with large size. Wide viewing angles and large numerals, without glass cover, eliminating glare.

【Environment-friendly Material】MDF, durable and vivid color, clear to read, no glass cover and no frame for the clock, creating a practical and beautiful combination. Precise quartz movements ensure accurate timekeeping.

【Non-ticking & Easy to Hang】Non-ticking, silent scanning movement (requires 1 AA battery - not included). Easy to hook for hanging on the wall (includes hook). Time accuracy and stable performance throughout its long life.
【Easy to Read】Wall clocks with different patterns are equipped with hands of different colors, which is convenient for you to read from any corner of the room.
【Widely Usage】Keep time fashionably, ideal for living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, classroom, guest room, office, dining room, cafe room, library, or any wall of any color.
